notes: Forty planned object classes remain fixed; missing classes are coverage gaps, not trained support.
Object detection and three-class single-bin crop classification are separate tasks.
Public-source labels are proposals until taxonomy, completeness, rights and grouping review.
COCO validation benchmark and earlier demo/smoke-test images are reserved from training.
Split related sessions, entities, sites and duplicate images together; frozen assignments cannot silently move.
Collection targets are planning aids and do not establish accuracy or model readiness.
